name: Wei Zhou
university: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
intro: I am an Associate Professor in the School of Automation at Nanjing University of Science and Technology (NJUST). My research focuses on embodied intelligence, computer vision, and multimodal foundation models, with applications in robotics and autonomous driving.
background: I received my Ph.D. from the School of Transportation at Southeast University in 2025 and my B.S. from NJUST in 2019. I joined NJUST in April 2025.

research.title: Embodied intelligence
research.text: Visual perception and multimodal learning for robots, with an interest in vision–language–action models and perception–decision systems.

research.title: Visual perception
research.text: Object detection, scene understanding, and learning with limited or cross-domain data in complex real-world environments.

research.title: Intelligent transportation
research.text: Traffic event understanding, pedestrian intention prediction, and visual perception for autonomous driving and road infrastructure.

news.text: Our paper “CARVE: Counterfactual Video Editing for Auditing and Hardening Video Detectors” is accepted at NeurIPS 2026.
news.label: Publications

news.text: Our paper on knowledge-guided soft-consensus learning for pavement crack inspection is published in Advanced Engineering Informatics.

news.text: Our review of closed-loop intelligent quality control for robotic welding is announced in Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing.
news.label: Paper
